name: Heaven of Blood Thaumaturgy
body:
Also known as the Path of Blood Resonance, this path reveals to the bloodlord the means by which they can manipulate their bloodline to change the world around them, summon or create creatures, and magically enhance themselves or others.

Base Attack Bonus: Equal to 1/2 their class level.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency: This path grants proficiency in all simple weapons but no armor or shields.

Class Skills: Fly (Dex), Knowledge (arcana, history, nobility, planes, religion) (Int), Linguistics (Int), Spellcraft (Int), and Use Magic Device (Cha).

Bonus Blood Talent: At 1st level, a bloodlord who chooses the heaven of blood thaumaturgy as their specialization gains minor sanguis magicae as a bonus blood talent in addition to their first blood talent.

Blood Caller: Through both the study of blood magic and summoning contracts, bloodlords have established an unique methodology for the bloodlord to call and summon creatures via their bloodlord spells. Starting at 1st level, spells with the calling or summoning descriptor will always require both the bloodlord’s blood as a blood material component and the material components, if there is any, normally listed in the spell’s description. The bloodlord can substitute any expensive material components for such spells with physical fragments, such as blood, bone, tissue samples, and so forth, of equal value that is normally found in the called or summoned creature’s species.

If there are no material components listed, the bloodlord will still require an inexpensive and negligible amount of physical fragments, as described above.

This methodology of calling and summoning creatures is possible due to the bloodlord creating a resonance between their blood and the material components to aid them in conjuring forth the called or summoned creatures. Hence why the bloodlord’s spell list contains some calling and summoning spells that would normally not be available to arcane spellcasters.

Cantrips: Bloodlords with the heaven of blood thaumaturgy can prepare a number of cantrips, or 0thlevel spells, each day, from the bloodlord spell list, and these number of 0th-level spells are on spells prepared table on page 21 under “Spells Prepared Per Day.”

These spells are cast like any other spell, but they are not expended when cast and may be used again. These spells otherwise follow all other rules for the bloodlord’s spells as described under minor sanguis magicae. While this ability is not a blood talent, the bloodlord must have minor sanguis magicae in order to cast a cantrip from the bloodlord spell list.

Augmentation (Su)

While the bloodlord has their blood burn active, they gain an enhancement bonus to all relevant Concentration checks and spell penetration checks, if any required, for their bloodlord class abilities equal to the value of their blood burn. In addition, they reduce the arcane spell failure chance for their bloodlord spells by an amount equal to 5% x the value of their blood burn.

Sanguine Biologist: Through both studying the wide field of biology and their own innate, almost instinctual, connection to blood, a bloodlord comes to understand that cells are the foundations of blood in living organisms that govern and sustain their very existence, whether it be their growth, maintaining their organic functions, or repairing injuries. Thus, bloodlords have learned healing magic that is uniquely suited to their expertise with blood magic.

Starting at 1st level, unless otherwise noted in the bloodlord’s spell list for a specific spell or in a spell’s description specifically for bloodlords, healing spells from the conjuration school, such as cure light wounds or reincarnate spy, cast by the bloodlord via any of the sanguis magicae blood talents are not conjuration spells with the healing descriptor. Instead, they are necromancy spells with the healing descriptor. Such spells cast by the bloodlord have the same effects as their conjuration counterparts, save that they are treated as necromancy spells for all intents and purposes.

While these spells do not use positive or negative energy, the effects of the spells are unchanged, including impact on living or undead creatures. In addition, the healing descriptor is added to any necromancy spell on the bloodlord spell list that manipulates positive or negative energy for healing purposes.

Heaven of Blood Thaumaturgy Bloodline Limits

A bloodlord can select a bonus feat, with any of the following tags shown below, or any one of the following: a bonus arcana, discovery, exploit, hex, bonus phrenic amplification, or talent.

Feats: blood hex, conduit, coven, damnation, familiar, item creation, item mastery, meditation, metamagic, and word of power.
Arcana: magus (core, Legendary)
Discovery: alchemist (core, Legendary), wizard (core, Legendary)
Exploit: arcanist (core, Legendary)
Hex: shaman (core, Legendary) but not spirit hexes, witch (core, Legendary)
Phrenic Amplification: psychic (core, Legendary)
Talent: investigator (core, Legendary)

If a chosen bonus feat/arcana/discovery/exploit/hex/phrenic amplification/talent has additional benefits that use a resource point cost, such as the points from an arcane reservoir or phrenic pool, the bloodlord can spend sanguine points from their blood bank as a free action to gain resource points that is immediately spent to gain the benefits listed in the chosen bonus feat/arcana/discovery/exploit/hex/phrenic amplification/talent from spending the relevant resource point cost.

The bloodlord can obtain 1 resource point for every 4 sanguine points they spend in this way. The bloodlord cannot spend the resource point gained this way on anything else but to gain the listed benefits through expending the resource point(s) cost of the chosen bonus feat/arcana/discovery/exploit/hex/phrenic amplification/talent and any unspent resource point is lost at the start of the bloodlord’s next turn.

If the chosen bonus feat/arcana/discovery/exploit/hex/phrenic amplification/talent has a BAB requirement of +11 or higher or a specific class level of 10 or higher, the bloodlord can only obtain 1 resource point for every 8 sanguine points they spend in this way – this represents the increased difficulty in mimicking the true masters of the highest Arts.

This does not grant the bloodlord a resource pool, thus they cannot benefit from any chosen bonus feat/arcana/discovery/exploit/hex/phrenic amplification/talent that requires a resource pool unless they already possess the relevant resource pool via another source, such as a class. The bloodlord cannot recover any resource point for the chosen bonus feat/arcana/discovery/exploit/hex/phrenic amplification/talent unless they already possess the means to do so via another source, such as a class.

Once the choice is made, the bloodlord cannot freely change the choice, but they can retrain the choice as per the retraining rules for a chosen bonus feat or ability, if appropriate.
